name: RV Chaos? [UPD]
desc:
UPDATE 2 OUT NOW!

Stranded deep in the wild backroads, you and your friends must drive, winch, and survive your way home in one barely-functional RV. Work together to cross rivers, climb cliffs, and recover from hilarious disasters in this chaotic co-op adventure. Can your crew make it back to the highway in one piece?

UPD 3: 80K 👍

Inspired by RV There Yet?
